criteria.quote: Why would Vulpix spit out its own endless flame?
criteria.revision: Replace the opening with: "Vulpix has a flame that never goes out—so why does hot weather make it release fire from its mouth?" This creates a clearer contradiction using only the research.

criteria.quote: As daytime temperatures rise, Vulpix releases flames from its mouth.
Why would Vulpix spit out its own endless flame?
criteria.revision: Delay the explanation and follow the question with: "Its body contains a flame that never goes out, but the reason for releasing it only appears when daytime temperatures rise." This preserves the open question before revealing the trigger.

criteria.quote: That release prevents Vulpix's body from growing too hot.
criteria.revision: Replace the repeated overheating scenes with the separate detail: "Vulpix can also manipulate balls of fire—and one entry says it uses them to catch prey." Then return to the hot-day release as a different use of its fire.

criteria.quote: Inside Vulpix burns a flame that never goes out.
criteria.revision: Make the reveal arrive after the hot-day setup: "The surprising part is that Vulpix is not creating this fire on demand: inside its body burns a flame that never goes out." This changes the meaning of the mouth-flame release without adding a new claim.

criteria.quote: Its permanent inner flame is released when daytime heat rises.
criteria.revision: Cut this scene because it restates the previous four. Use the research-backed contrast instead: "On hot days, Vulpix releases flames to keep its body from growing too hot; elsewhere, it manipulates fireballs to catch prey."

criteria.quote: On hot days, Vulpix releases flames from its mouth to prevent its body from growing too hot.
criteria.revision: End with: "So Vulpix's fire is not described in just one way: on hot days, it releases flames to prevent overheating, while it can also manipulate fireballs to catch prey." This answers the opening and adds the stronger contrast.

criteria.quote: Is Vulpix mainly a heat regulator or fireball maker?
criteria.revision: Change it to: "When you think about Vulpix's fire, which detail matters more: its hot-day release that prevents overheating, or its ability to manipulate fireballs to catch prey?" Both sides are directly supported by the research.
